question: Which state announced plans to build India's first quantum computing village in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** has announced plans to establish **India's first Quantum Computing Village** by the year **2025**.
 
• The aim of this project is to **promote research and development in quantum computing technology** and establish India as a global hub for quantum technology and innovation.
 
• This initiative is expected to attract investments, create job opportunities, and contribute to the development of a knowledge-based economy in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The project aligns with the Government of India's focus on fostering cutting-edge technology and innovation as part of its **Digital India and Atmanirbhar Bharat (Self-Reliant India)** missions.
 
• The village will offer facilities such as research labs, collaboration spaces, and training centers for students, researchers, and entrepreneurs working in quantum computing and related fields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Quantum Computing:**

 
 
• **Quantum computing** is an advanced field of computing that uses principles of **quantum mechanics**, such as superposition and entanglement, to perform calculations much faster than classical computers.
 
• It has applications in areas like **cryptography, artificial intelligence, materials science, and optimization problems**.
 
• Leading global tech companies like IBM, Google, and Microsoft are actively investing in quantum computing research.
 
 
 
• **India's Quantum Mission:**
 
 
• The Indian government launched the **National Quantum Mission** in 2023, with an outlay of **Rs. 6,000 crore**, to boost research and development in quantum technologies.
 
• The mission aims to make India a global leader in quantum technologies by 2031.
 
• It includes objectives such as developing quantum computers, quantum communication systems, and quantum sensing technologies.
 
 
 
• **Role of Andhra Pradesh in Technology:**
 
 
• Andhra Pradesh has been a frontrunner in adopting and promoting advanced technologies, with initiatives like **Fintech Valley Vizag** and collaborations with global tech companies.
 
• The state government has also launched policies to support startups and foster innovation, such as the **Andhra Pradesh Innovation and Startup Policy**.
 
• The establishment of the Quantum Computing Village further strengthens Andhra Pradesh's position as a hub for technology and innovation.
 
 
 
• **Global Quantum Computing Initiatives:**
 
 
• Countries like the **United States, China, and Germany** are leading in quantum computing research and development.
 
• The European Union has launched the **Quantum Flagship Program** with a budget of €1 billion to advance quantum technologies.
 
• China has developed a 66-qubit quantum computer called **"Zuchongzhi"**, which is one of the most advanced quantum computers in the world.
